title: * Fix nbd autopkgtests to make the initrd-boot autopkgtest more robust and
commit_message:
* Fix nbd autopkgtests to make the initrd-boot autopkgtest more robust and
  remove the flaky tag (LP: #2054480)
  - d/t/control: remove flaky for initrd-boot, allow-root for initrd-boot test
  - d/t/initrd-boot: make initrd-boot pass on all architectures
    + Allocate swap space to not run out of memory
    + Changes for s390x and ppc64el (LP: #2078255)
      - Change file permissions for home and System.map
      - Add custom apparmor config to allow unshare to run with --keep-caps
      - Disable vga in debvm-run to avoid failing on ppc64el
      - Disable early failure as debvm-waitssh might fail on some
        architectures even when the test might pass

diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 661aa4d..5b41e63 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,19 @@
+nbd (1:3.26.1-1ubuntu0.2) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * Fix nbd autopkgtests to make the initrd-boot autopkgtest more robust and
+    remove the flaky tag (LP: #2054480)
+    - d/t/control: remove flaky for initrd-boot, allow-root for initrd-boot test
+    - d/t/initrd-boot: make initrd-boot pass on all architectures
+      + Allocate swap space to not run out of memory (except armhf where it is
+        not possible on prodstack)
+      + Changes for s390x and ppc64el (LP: #2078255)
+        - Disable vga in debvm-run to avoid failing on ppc64el
+        - Disable early failure as debvm-waitssh might fail on some
+          architectures even when the test might pass
+        - Use -cpu max option to allow fallback to tcg if kvm is unavailable
+
+ -- Pragyansh Chaturvedi <pragyansh.chaturvedi@canonical.com>  Fri, 24 Jan 2025 00:03:45 +0530

diff --git a/debian/tests/initrd-boot b/debian/tests/initrd-boot
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6fb74ad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/initrd-boot
@@ -0,0 +1,125 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+
+set -exu
+
+TMPDIR="${AUTOPKGTEST_TMP:-/tmp}"
+OUTDIR="${AUTOPKGTEST_ARTIFACTS:-/tmp}"
+# We need TMPDIR to be world-readable for unshare to read it (used in creation
+# of our VM image below)
+chmod a+rx "$TMPDIR"
+
+eval "$(grep "^ID=" /etc/os-release)"
+if [ "$ID" = "ubuntu" ]; then
+    COMPONENTS=main,universe
+    INCLUDES=e2fsprogs,zstd,openssh-server
+    EXTRAS=--keyring=/usr/share/keyrings/ubuntu-archive-keyring.gpg
+else
+    COMPONENTS=main
+    INCLUDES=openssh-server
+    EXTRAS=
+fi
+
+# Generate an SSH key which we'll use to access the VM remotely
+ssh-keygen -q -t rsa -f "$TMPDIR"/id_rsa -N ""
+
+# Construct a VM image of the "current" (i.e. this chroot's) release, including
+# the SSH key we generated, and include the nbd-client package. We use a hook
+# to ensure our apt sources-and-preferences match the new VM's
+IMAGE="$TMPDIR"/nbd.img
+touch $IMAGE
+
+# Check if the architecture is armhf, and only attempt to enable swap if it's not
+if ! [ $(uname -m) = "armv7l" ]; then
+    # Allocate some swap
+    fallocate -l 2G /swapfile
+    chmod 600 /swapfile
+    mkswap /swapfile
+    swapon /swapfile
+else
+    echo "Skipping swap activation on armhf architecture"
+fi
+
+# Configure and start up the nbd-server pointing at the new VM image
+cat > "$TMPDIR"/myvm.conf << EOF
+[myvm]
+exportname = $IMAGE
+EOF
+cp "$TMPDIR"/myvm.conf /etc/nbd-server/conf.d/
+chown nbd:nbd "$IMAGE"
+systemctl restart nbd-server.service
+
+# If this fails locally, allocate more space to /tmp
+TEMPROOT="$(mktemp -d)"
+mmdebstrap \
+    noble \
+    $TEMPROOT \
+    --include=login \
+    --customize-hook=/usr/share/debvm/customize-autologin.sh \
+    --customize-hook=/usr/share/debvm/customize-dpkgavailable.sh \
+    --skip=cleanup/apt/lists \
+    --include=openssh-server \
+    --customize-hook="mkdir -m700 -p ${TEMPROOT}/root/.ssh" \
+    --customize-hook="upload ${TMPDIR}/id_rsa.pub /root/.ssh/authorized_keys" \
+    --customize-hook=/usr/share/debvm/customize-networkd.sh \
+    --include=libnss-resolve \
+    --customize-hook=/usr/share/debvm/customize-resolved.sh \
+    --customize-hook="passwd --root ${TEMPROOT} --delete root" \
+    --customize-hook="echo testvm >${TEMPROOT}/etc/hostname" \
+    --customize-hook="echo 127.0.0.1 localhost testvm >${TEMPROOT}/etc/hosts" \
+    --include=systemd-sysv \
+    --mode=root \
+    --verbose \
+    --variant=apt \
+    --format=directory \
+    --skip=output/dev \
+    --customize-hook="echo 'LABEL=debvm / ext4 defaults 0 0' >${TEMPROOT}/etc/fstab" \
+    --customize-hook=/usr/share/debvm/customize-kernel.sh \
+    --mode=unshare \
+    --hook-dir=/usr/share/mmdebstrap/hooks/copy-host-apt-sources-and-preferences \
+    --hook-dir=/usr/share/mmdebstrap/hooks/file-mirror-automount \
+    --hook-dir=/usr/share/mmdebstrap/hooks/maybe-merged-usr \
+    --include=e2fsprogs,zstd,openssh-server,nbd-client \
+    --components="$COMPONENTS" \
+    $EXTRAS
+
+/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -L debvm -d $TEMPROOT $IMAGE 4G
+chown nbd:nbd "$IMAGE"
+
+# Start a VM from the template, skipping the root device and cmdline
+# definitions. This will use the kernel and initrd from the template (extracted
+# via debugfs), but not the image itself. The rootfs will come from the nbd
+# server (at least, that's what we hope!)
+# Run with the -cpu max option to allow fallback to TCG in case KVM is not
+# available
+(
+    timeout -k 120s 1800s debvm-run \
+        --image="$IMAGE" \
+        --sshport=8022 \
+        --skip=root \
+        --append="nbdroot=10.0.2.2/myvm root=/dev/nbd0" \
+        -- -vga none -cpu max
+) </dev/null >"$OUTDIR"/debvm.log 2>&1 &
+
+# the default of 60 seconds can be too slow for salsaci
+# debvm-waitssh sometimes fails even when the ssh server is up
+# so keeping the timeout here lower than debvm-run
+# Also, on some architectures (ppc64el on noble), debvm-waitssh
+# times out even when an ssh-server is up. So if the timeout
+# should not be considered a failure, as a genuine failure
+# would eventually fail in later steps
+debvm-waitssh -t 1200 8022 || true
+
+# the default ssh command does not store known hosts and even ignores host keys
+# it identifies itself with the rsa key generated above
+# pseudo terminal allocation is disabled or otherwise, programs executed via
+# ssh might wait for input on stdin of the ssh process
+ssh="ssh -o ConnectTimeout=20 -o NoHostAuthenticationForLocalhost=yes -i $TMPDIR/id_rsa -T -p 8022"
+
+# Check (and show!) the root device is /dev/nbd0
+$ssh root@localhost -- "cat /proc/mounts" > "$OUTDIR"/mounts
+cat "$OUTDIR"/mounts
+awk '$1=="/dev/nbd0" && $2=="/" { print; }' "$OUTDIR"/mounts | grep "/"
+
+# shut the system off
+trap - EXIT
+$ssh root@localhost -- systemctl poweroff || :
